description: List official LDA issue codes, filing types, government entities, contribution types, countries and states, or explain identifiers, methodology and FARA rules. Optional filter performs case-insensitive literal token-AND matching across the complete vocabulary. Each call returns a fixed window of up to 125 whole entries; follow next_cursor for the rest. LDA filter codes are the value of entries with source lda, such as US or CN for countries and WA for states. Countries also list FARA country/location labels (source fara) for the uslobbying_search_foreign_agents country filter; they are source spellings, not ISO codes, and never valid LDA filter values.

cursor.description: Pinned continuation; omit original topic/filter or repeat them unchanged.

filter.description: Every whitespace-separated token must occur literally in an entry.

topic.description: Vocabulary or explanatory topic; required on the first call.

name: uslobbying_list_reference

cursor_expires_at.description: Absolute expiry of the pinned vocabulary and its continuations.

entries.description: Whole entries delivered in this fixed 125-entry window.

items.description: One attributed vocabulary entry or methodology explanation.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: The first call omits topic. `cursor_invalid`: A cursor is unavailable or expired, belongs to another tenant or tool, or arrives with a changed topic or filter. `acquisition_storage_unavailable`: Storage cannot retain the complete vocabulary or its checkpoint safely. `source_schema_changed`: Source vocabulary violates its verified schema. `snapshot_unavailable`: Required FARA country snapshot is unavailable. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

matched_entries.description: Entries matching every literal filter token.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation of the pinned vocabulary.

output_complete.description: Whether every matched entry has been delivered.

records_returned.description: Whole entries delivered in this window.

retrieved_at.description: Retrieval timestamp: the shared LDA constants fetch for LDA topics (the older of the LDA and FARA retrievals for countries), the call time for explanatory topics.

truncated.description: More matched entries remain; follow next_cursor.

title: Uslobbying List Reference
